newsitem.title: USA: Dollar ends flat vs mark, higher against yen.
newsitem.headline: Dollar ends flat vs mark, higher against yen.

text.p: *Dlr ends flat vs mark, up vs yen. Yeltsin firing military chief Kolesnikov had little impact in late trade.
*Dlr/mark recovers from dip post disappointing US Aug trade data, pulled up in part by stg/mark surge to 22-month high.
*Dlr/yen flirted with 112.60 resistance, up on overall bullish dollar sentiment.Dealers see stg/mark as synthetic dollar position.
